author: Lindsay Ellis
description:
My cruise line video was just taken down over truly the dumbest copyright claim by Warner Chappell. I am fighting this vexatious strike right now, but it shows how broken the system is. In the meantime, the video is still available on Nebula ad free: 
https://nebula.tv/videos/lindsayellis-i-tested-every-cruise-line-to-find-the-least-evil No, this is not a bit. Share your vexatious copyright bs experiences below for the #engagement.👇
#shorts #fairuse #copyrightstrike #youtubecreator #cruisevlog
